question: root cause of 100ms->3s /search spike
root_cause: Three effects, none store-related: (1) steady state ~113ms; (2) cold-start one-time ~250ms (cold HNSW segment + reranker warmup); (3) 2100ms spike = CONTENTION on shared --parallel-2 llama-server when embed/rerank/gemma overlap (benchmark fired 4 GPU calls/query). Fix = more parallel slots or dedicated rerank instance. Independent of Chroma vs ArcadeDB.
